summary: Incremental case opener: open CS-style cases by hand, sell the skins, automate everything, and escalate from calm to casino-on-drugs.
description: A Scritchy Scratchy-style incremental game with weapon cases instead of scratch tickets. Buy a case, drag the key in, watch the reel, drag the skin to the sell bin; upgrades and new cases unlock as you go, and the screen escalates from sober to cyberpsychosis.
provides: case opening with a CS-style reel and near misses
skins with rarity, wear and StatTrak
intensity stages that escalate the visuals
a Trophy Case lobby tab (server inventory)
a four-run campaign with The Last Case, evolutions, the Upgrader and the credits
Solana wallet sign-in, with wallet players marked on the board
